core.title: Emit every generated component with its complete required structure
core.then: Emit it with its complete required structure: a URN matching the stack's component URN shape (profile: urn.component); a required parent feature equal to the input feature URN; a description following the template 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns'; consumed events taken from feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by the component's role and produced events from feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by its capability, at most 3 each; and dependencies listing the other components in the same feature plus the external dependencies.
prefer: Use {side}, not the older {tier}, as the URN segment naming the side of the system.
avoid: Omitting the parent feature, or exceeding 3 consumed or 3 produced events (e.g. 5 produced events).
Free-form descriptions, unfiltered copies of all ioSeeds events, or dropping either same-feature components or external dependencies from the dependency list.
Treating a missing input feature URN as making this rule inapplicable; the parent feature is required, so emitting without it is a violation.
core.why: Pinning down the full required shape — parent feature, description, bounded events, dependencies — ensures every component the planner emits is complete and consistently structured for downstream phases.
evidence: Each emitted component has a URN matching the stack's component URN shape (profile: urn.component).
Each component has a non-empty parent feature equal to the input feature URN; a component emitted without one (including when the input lacked a feature URN) fails.
Description matches 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns' with the component's own values.

consumes has length <= 3 and contains only feature.ioSeeds.consume events relevant to the component's role; produces has length <= 3 and contains only feature.ioSeeds.produce events matching the component's capability (role/capability filter applied, not an arbitrary subset).
The dependencies list includes both categories: the other components in the same feature plus the external dependencies.
Compliant shape: URN, required parent feature, templated description, <=3 consumes, <=3 produces, dependencies listed.
verification: The check applies to every component the planner emits (initial emission or regeneration), regardless of whether the input supplies a feature URN; a missing input feature URN is not an exemption.
Verify each component's URN against the stack's component URN shape (profile key urn.component).
Verify the parent feature: source is the feature URN from the input; it is required, so a component emitted without one fails.
Verify the description against the template 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns' using the component's own values.

Verify events: consumes sourced from feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by the component's role, produces sourced from feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by its capability, each capped at 3; check that the role/capability filter was applied, not an arbitrary subset.
Verify the dependencies list includes both categories: the other components in the same feature plus the external dependencies.
Flag the canonical counter-examples: a component emitted with no parent feature, or with 5 produced events.

Not covered by the check: how role/capability map to individual events, the selection order when more than 3 events survive filtering, and where external dependencies are discovered — the source is silent on these; check filtering relevance and caps, not a particular selection.

fires: The planner generates and emits any component entry (initial emission), whether or not the input supplies a feature URN.
The planner emits a component while the input feature URN is missing — the rule fires and the missing required parent is a violation.
doesNotFire: Editing implementation code in a component's layer without the planner emitting a component.
Authoring other plan artifacts (wagons, WMBTs, acceptances) or docs that emit no component.
Unrelated edits to a plan file that do not generate or emit a component.

neutralityNotes: The obligation is plan-level and already stack-neutral: 'planner' is the planning-phase role, and wagon/feature/business_capability/side/layer/ioSeeds belong to the shared ATDD plan model that the closed vocabulary itself endorses (urn.wagon, urn.wmbt, layout.wagon_dir), so they are kept in the core rather than pushed to the profile. The only stack datum the core needs is the component URN shape, supplied by the existing key urn.component. The description template is convention content, not stack data, so it stays in the core. prefer[0]'s {side}-over-{tier} guidance is convention history, retained. Concrete instance examples (reference URN, event names, dependency identifiers) are not repeated in the core; they remain in bun.json as the worked reference example (bunOnly). Activation-fact explanatory notes from bun.json are metadata, not obligations, and are represented by the observability values.
